note: Config for /report/stablecoin-yield-ranking (see the build spec). Unlike the polygon/xrp venue files this is NOT a per-pool allowlist: the report's external rows are discovered live from the Portals API as the top N stablecoin venues per network, constrained by everything below. The curation lives in the platform set, the symbol filters and the floors, so a junk pool cannot enter no matter what APY it advertises. scripts/fetch-stablecoin-yield.mjs consumes this and writes data/stablecoin-yield.json.

tradfi.note: Hand-maintained editorial reference figures for the savings-account comparison section. VERIFY BEFORE EVERY MERGE that touches them; the page renders these with explicit as-of language. Not sourced from any API.

regulation.note: Hand-maintained. The page states the DURABLE mechanism (an issuer keeps its reserve interest, which is why yield has to come from somewhere else) as settled prose, and renders anything time-sensitive from the fields below with explicit as-of language. VERIFY BEFORE EVERY MERGE. Legislative status moves faster than this file does, and a stale claim about the law is worse than no claim. If `pendingQuestionOpen` is set to false the page drops the open-question paragraph entirely rather than describing a debate that has ended.
regulation.issuerActEffect: bars a payment stablecoin issuer from paying interest or yield to holders of the coin it issues
regulation.pendingQuestion: whether that restriction reaches exchanges and other intermediaries that pass a rate through to their own customers, rather than only the issuer
